facts.business: Jagran Prakashan Limited is a multi-platform media conglomerate operating across print, radio, digital, outdoor, and on-ground activation verticals, publishing newspapers in 10 languages and engaging millions across India.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital work-in-progress (machinery under erection and building under construction)
Capital expenditure contracted but not recognised (net of advances)

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on pending NCLT petition by certain promoters against other promoters and promoter group members, and appeal filed with NCLAT against holding company's request for EGM to remove directors; implementation of EGM resolution kept in abeyance. Management does not expect impact on financial statements.

key_risks: Impairment risk due to net assets exceeding market capitalisation
Ongoing promoter disputes and NCLT/NCLAT proceedings
Dependence on advertising revenue across cyclical media segments
Technological disruption and shifting consumption patterns
Regulatory and license fee commitments for radio business
facts.related_party_note: Corporate guarantee of Rs 2,145 lakh given to ICICI Bank for Midday Infomedia Limited (wholly owned subsidiary); term loan repaid during year. Receivables from associates Jagran Publications Private Limited and Jagran Prakashan (MPC) Private Limited fully provided and written off in FY20; disputes ongoing. Investments in these associates not consolidated due to severe long-term restrictions.
